name: PictureBooks
original_description: Create private illustrated storybooks from your ideas, follow generation progress, and read stories saved in your PictureBooks account. Built for parents, caregivers, educators, and other adult authors. Connect your existing account to check available credits and create books using those credits. The plugin does not purchase credits, charge a card, or publish your books. You can disconnect access in PictureBooks at any time.
summary_ja: アイデアから非公開の絵本を作成し、生成状況や保存した作品を確認する。
limitations_ja: 保護者・教育者など大人向け。既存アカウントのクレジットを使用し、プラグインはクレジット購入、カード決済、作品公開を行わないと説明。実動作や料金は未検証。
